text.tspan: Terms — traceId: call chain of one request (Micrometer Tracing, W3C traceparent) · correlationId: business ID linking requests and events (X-Correlation-Id + baggage) · X-Request-Id: gateway request number
Break ① saga step calls are not linked to T1 · C1 — findable only by step key sagaId:STEP (idempotency key)
Break ② across Kafka the trace does not continue, and correlationId is not passed to the next event
Zipkin: one trace each (T1 · T2 · T3 · T4) · Kibana (pmart-logs): search by traceId · correlationId fields
to follow one saga today, stitch by orderId · sagaId · eventId (envelope · dead_letter · inbox_event)

To fix (backlog, platform-capabilities-code-map.md): ① context propagation (trace · MDC) in the saga executor ② carry traceparent outbox → Kafka header on publish, restore context from envelope traceId · correlationId on consume ③ correlationId = sagaId for saga events and participant calls

svg.text: POST /order-drafts/{id}/checkouts (X-Correlation-Id kept if the app sends one)
RequestIdWebFilter → issue X-Request-Id
Micrometer starts trace T1
traceparent T1 · X-Request-Id · (X-Correlation-Id)
CorrelationIdFilter → issue C1 if missing · MDC traceId=T1, correlationId=C1
RestClient — traceparent T1 · X-Correlation-Id C1 (ServiceCallHeadersCustomizer + baggage)
MDC traceId=T1, correlationId=C1 · INSERT checkout_saga (sagaId S)
CheckoutSagaStateChanged — envelope traceId=T1 · correlationId=C1
(EventEnvelopeCodec.create reads MDC → outbox trace_id · correlation_id)
logs (traceId T1 · correlationId C1) · span T1
advance() — the virtual-thread executor (OrchestrationConfig) does not carry trace · MDC
steps b~f over HTTP — new trace T2 · no X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationIdFilter → issues a new C2
POST /payment-confirmations (new request)
traceparent T3 · X-Request-Id
MDC traceId=T3, correlationId=C3 (newly issued)
PaymentApproved — envelope traceId=T3 · correlationId=C3 (same TX)
Debezium EventRouter — Kafka headers traceId=T3 · correlationId=C3
(no traceparent header)
Stream binding — EventConsumers → InboxGuard
new trace T4 · MDC empty
no code restores envelope traceId=T3 · correlationId=C3 into tracing context · MDC
events emitted by this reaction — correlationId = MDC (none) → empty
h2 confirm order over HTTP (new trace)
OrderConfirmed — correlationId = sagaId S (set explicitly by OrderService)
→ the only place that links the confirmed fact to the saga
